limitations: A consumed current slot is not a window-write permit: existing preference, generation and final native-begin freshness checks follow it.
Consumption before the callback trace establishes that the earlier actor application path took the one-shot slot; it does not measure OS scheduling intent.
Consumption trace ages precede the callback's optional preference read; expiredNewReadAtAcceptance and ownership events must also be inspected.
A request still pending at shutdown is not inferred to have completed or been accepted.
Non-selection submissions require correlation with acceptance events to establish a join/detach handler; they are not counted as external R4 presses.
